findings.message:
vendorHash is inlined in packages.nix. Consider extracting it to a dedicated file (e.g., vendorHash.nix) and importing it: vendorHash = import ./vendorHash.nix;

Benefits: cleaner diffs (+1 −1), trivially scriptable, better tool interop with nix-update/nvfetcher.
findings.suggestion: Create vendorHash.nix with the hash value, then replace the inline attribute with: vendorHash = import ./vendorHash.nix;
